plugins.name: skill-forge
plugins.description: Guided wizard to design and build agents, skills, and plugins with zero-hole definition, orchestrator + single-task subagents, guardrail hooks, a live best-practices KB, and an HTML approval view.

plugins.name: delegation
plugins.description: Hand token-heavy, low-reasoning tasks to free models: text to local Ollama, file work to an opencode agent (local when the material has data, free cloud when it has none), with a data scan, a model allowlist and a benchmark.

plugins.name: knowledge-base
plugins.description: Read, explain, correct, and research the global knowledge base with the kb CLI (INDEX.md fallback), three-gate research pipeline with single-task agents, and a hook that asks before any KB write outside .raw/.

plugins.name: agent-team
plugins.description: Run a repo's work as tracked tickets (GitHub issues) through a team of single-task agents: run-task orchestrates plan, design, build and quality agents behind gates; hooks guard write scopes, ticket verdicts, owner approval and knowledge freshness (kb stale). Active only in repos with .claude/agent-team.json.
